description: Market structure, liquidity, auction and execution-context event catalogue. Most concepts require configurable pivot, range and volume definitions.

items.name: Higher High (HH)
items.definition: Confirmed swing high exceeds prior confirmed swing high.
items.detection_outline: Compare chronologically confirmed pivot highs.
items.invalidation_rule: Invalidated by later structure reclassification only under explicit rule.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Higher Low (HL)
items.definition: Confirmed swing low exceeds prior confirmed swing low.
items.detection_outline: Compare confirmed pivot lows.
items.confirmation_rule: Subsequent bullish continuation or hold above prior low.
items.invalidation_rule: Break below the defining higher low.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Lower High (LH)
items.definition: Confirmed swing high is below prior confirmed swing high.
items.detection_outline: Compare confirmed pivot highs.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Lower Low (LL)
items.definition: Confirmed swing low is below prior confirmed swing low.
items.detection_outline: Compare confirmed pivot lows.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Bullish Break of Structure (BOS)
items.definition: Price breaks a prior meaningful swing high in an established bullish structure.
items.detection_outline: Choose major/minor swing algorithm; detect close above level plus buffer.
items.invalidation_rule: Close back below broken level / swing structure failure.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Bearish Break of Structure (BOS)
items.definition: Price breaks a prior meaningful swing low in bearish structure.
items.detection_outline: Detect close below confirmed swing low plus buffer.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Bullish Change of Character (CHoCH)
items.definition: First meaningful break against preceding bearish swing sequence.
items.detection_outline: Track LL/LH sequence; break above last lower high.
items.confirmation_rule: New higher low and higher high.
items.invalidation_rule: New lower low before bullish sequence established.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Bearish Change of Character (CHoCH)
items.definition: First meaningful break against preceding bullish swing sequence.
items.detection_outline: Track HH/HL sequence; break below last higher low.
items.confirmation_rule: New lower high and lower low.
items.invalidation_rule: New higher high before bearish sequence established.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Bullish Market Structure Shift (MSS)
items.definition: Displacement breaks a key internal/external high after sell-side liquidity event.
items.detection_outline: Require sweep/event plus displacement close through confirmed structure level.
items.invalidation_rule: Return below displacement origin or swept low.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Bearish Market Structure Shift (MSS)
items.definition: Displacement breaks a key low after buy-side liquidity event.
items.detection_outline: Require buy-side sweep plus displacement close through structure low.
items.invalidation_rule: Return above displacement origin or swept high.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Internal Structure Break
items.definition: Break of a minor swing within larger external range.
items.detection_outline: Maintain separate internal swing hierarchy and detect level break.
items.confirmation_rule: Contextual only; combine with external trend.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: External Structure Break
items.definition: Break of a major swing that defines higher-level market structure.
items.detection_outline: Use higher prominence/scale pivots and close beyond boundary.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Equal Highs Liquidity Pool
items.definition: Cluster of highs within configurable price tolerance.
items.detection_outline: Cluster confirmed swing highs by ATR/percent tolerance and spacing.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Equal Lows Liquidity Pool
items.definition: Cluster of lows within configurable price tolerance.
items.detection_outline: Cluster confirmed swing lows.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Buy-Side Liquidity Sweep
items.definition: Price trades above highs/liquidity pool then rejects back below.
items.detection_outline: Detect high above confirmed liquidity pool, close back below within N bars.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Sell-Side Liquidity Sweep
items.definition: Price trades below lows/liquidity pool then reclaims above.
items.detection_outline: Detect low below confirmed pool and close back above.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Internal Liquidity Sweep
items.definition: Sweep of a minor swing within the external dealing range.
items.detection_outline: Apply sweep test to internal pivots only.
items.confirmation_rule: Use as context for entry timing.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: External Liquidity Sweep
items.definition: Sweep of major external high/low or prior day/week extreme.
items.detection_outline: Detect trade beyond confirmed HTF level then rejection.
items.confirmation_rule: Structure shift away from swept liquidity.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Bullish Fair Value Gap (FVG)
items.definition: Three-candle gap between first candle high and third candle low.
items.detection_outline: For bars t-2,t: low[t] > high[t-2], optionally require displacement body.
items.confirmation_rule: Price retraces into gap and rejects or continues above.
items.invalidation_rule: Full mitigation/close below gap lower bound per chosen rule.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Bearish Fair Value Gap (FVG)
items.definition: Three-candle gap between first candle low and third candle high.
items.detection_outline: high[t] < low[t-2], optionally displacement body.
items.confirmation_rule: Retrace into gap and reject lower.
items.invalidation_rule: Full mitigation/close above gap upper bound.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Bullish Inverse FVG (IFVG)
items.definition: Prior bearish gap is traded through and later acts as support.
items.detection_outline: Track bearish FVG; require close through upper edge then retest from above.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Bearish Inverse FVG (IFVG)
items.definition: Prior bullish gap is traded through and later acts as resistance.
items.detection_outline: Track bullish FVG; require close through lower edge then retest from below.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Bullish Volume Imbalance
items.definition: Adjacent candles show a gap between body edges under selected body-only convention.
items.detection_outline: Compare prior close/open body edge to next open/close using explicit definition.
items.confirmation_rule: Revisit/reaction only; not a universal gap.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Bearish Volume Imbalance
items.definition: Adjacent candles show bearish body-edge imbalance.
items.detection_outline: Use explicit body-only gap definition.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Bullish Order Block (heuristic)
items.definition: Last bearish candle or down-close cluster before bullish displacement and structure break.
items.detection_outline: Find bearish candle before displacement; define zone by full range or body; require BOS.
items.confirmation_rule: Retest zone with reaction and structure confirmation.
items.invalidation_rule: Close below zone low or origin swing.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Bearish Order Block (heuristic)
items.definition: Last bullish candle or up-close cluster before bearish displacement and structure break.
items.detection_outline: Find bullish candle before bearish displacement; require BOS.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Bullish Breaker Block
items.definition: Failed bearish order block flips to support after upside break.
items.detection_outline: Track bearish OB invalidation by bullish displacement; retain zone.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Bearish Breaker Block
items.definition: Failed bullish order block flips to resistance after downside break.
items.detection_outline: Track bullish OB invalidation by bearish displacement.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Bullish Mitigation Block
items.definition: Zone revisited after an opposing position is unwound under chosen methodology.
items.detection_outline: Use explicit swing/OB sequence definition; do not infer participant intent.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Bearish Mitigation Block
items.definition: Bearish counterpart of mitigation block.
items.detection_outline: Use explicit sequence and zone rules.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Bullish Rejection Block
items.definition: Swing-low wick rejection zone followed by meaningful bullish displacement.
items.detection_outline: Define wick/body zone and require later structure break.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Bearish Rejection Block
items.definition: Swing-high wick rejection zone followed by meaningful bearish displacement.
items.detection_outline: Define wick/body zone and require structure break.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Premium Zone
items.definition: Price above midpoint of selected dealing range.
items.detection_outline: Select confirmed dealing-range high/low; premium if price > 50% equilibrium.
items.invalidation_rule: Range redefinition or price below midpoint.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Discount Zone
items.definition: Price below midpoint of selected dealing range.
items.detection_outline: Use confirmed dealing range; discount if price < 50% equilibrium.
items.invalidation_rule: Range redefinition or price above midpoint.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Equilibrium (50%)
items.definition: Midpoint of selected dealing range.
items.detection_outline: (range_high+range_low)/2 from point-in-time anchors.
items.invalidation_rule: Anchors change only when rule permits.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Optimal Trade Entry (OTE) Zone
items.definition: Retracement region commonly defined around 62%-79% of a selected impulse leg.
items.detection_outline: Use confirmed impulse endpoints and exact ratio convention.
items.confirmation_rule: Need structure shift / candle confirmation within zone.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Consequent Encroachment (CE)
items.definition: Midpoint of a gap/imbalance zone.
items.detection_outline: Calculate midpoint of defined FVG/imbalance.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Breaker Retest
items.definition: Price retests a flipped failed block from the other side.
items.detection_outline: Track block break then touch within tolerance.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Liquidity Void
items.definition: Fast one-directional move with little two-sided trading/overlap.
items.detection_outline: Measure consecutive displacement bars, low overlap and volume/profile sparsity.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Bullish Displacement
items.definition: Unusually large bullish body/range relative to recent volatility.
items.detection_outline: Body and true range exceed rolling percentile/ATR threshold; close near high.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Bearish Displacement
items.definition: Unusually large bearish body/range relative to recent volatility.
items.detection_outline: Body/range above threshold and close near low.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Consolidation / Dealing Range
items.definition: Price rotates between measurable support and resistance zones.
items.detection_outline: Cluster confirmed pivots and bound range duration/depth.
items.confirmation_rule: Wait for acceptance outside or fade edges after rejection.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Acceptance Above Range
items.definition: Price spends defined time/volume above former range resistance.
items.detection_outline: Require N closes or fraction of volume above upper bound.
items.confirmation_rule: Retest holds or value migrates upward.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Acceptance Below Range
items.definition: Price spends defined time/volume below former range support.
items.detection_outline: Require N closes or volume below lower bound.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Rejection Above Range
items.definition: Probe above range fails and price closes/accepts back inside.
items.detection_outline: Detect excursion above range then return and failed retest.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Rejection Below Range
items.definition: Probe below range fails and price reclaims range.
items.detection_outline: Detect excursion below lower bound and close back inside.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: VWAP Reclaim
items.definition: Price recovers session VWAP after trading below it.
items.detection_outline: Compute session VWAP and detect close/cross above from below.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: VWAP Rejection
items.definition: Price tests session VWAP from below and fails.
items.detection_outline: Detect approach/touch and bearish close back below.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Prior Day High Sweep
items.definition: Current session trades above prior day high then rejects.
items.detection_outline: Use correct exchange session and adjusted data; detect high beyond PDH then close below.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Prior Day Low Sweep
items.definition: Current session trades below prior day low then reclaims.
items.detection_outline: Detect low below PDL and close above.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Prior Week High Sweep
items.definition: Price sweeps prior completed week high.
items.detection_outline: Use completed weekly bar only; detect excursion/reclaim.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Prior Week Low Sweep
items.definition: Price sweeps prior completed week low.
items.detection_outline: Use completed weekly bar only.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Opening Range High Sweep
items.definition: Opening range high is exceeded then reclaimed lower.
items.detection_outline: Build completed opening range; detect false breakout.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Opening Range Low Sweep
items.definition: Opening range low is breached then reclaimed.
items.detection_outline: Build completed opening range; detect false breakdown.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Up Trend Day
items.definition: Session develops directional upward auction with shallow pullbacks and higher value.
items.detection_outline: Session range progression, VWAP position, close location and profile migration.
items.confirmation_rule: Use intraday pullback continuation; not known at open.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Down Trend Day
items.definition: Session develops directional downward auction with shallow rallies.
items.detection_outline: Mirror up trend day measurements.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Neutral Day
items.definition: Session rotates around value with two-sided trade and limited directional extension.
items.detection_outline: Measure range, VWAP crossings, value-area overlap and close location.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Double Distribution Day
items.definition: Two volume/TPO distributions separated by low-volume region.
items.detection_outline: Build profile and detect two peaks with valley threshold.
items.confirmation_rule: Breakout/acceptance from one distribution to the other.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Poor High
items.definition: Profile high has multiple TPOs/trades at extreme rather than a single excess tail.
items.detection_outline: Detect terminal price level with excess criterion not satisfied.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Poor Low
items.definition: Profile low lacks single-print/excess tail under selected TPO rules.
items.detection_outline: Detect terminal price level with inadequate excess.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Single Prints
items.definition: One TPO print at price levels during directional auction.
items.detection_outline: Build TPO profile; detect contiguous single-print price bins.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Excess High
items.definition: Clear rejection tail at profile high.
items.detection_outline: Use TPO/volume profile tail length and terminal print count.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Excess Low
items.definition: Clear rejection tail at profile low.
items.detection_outline: Use terminal tail/excess criteria.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Value Area Migration Up
items.definition: Value area and POC shift higher across sessions.
items.detection_outline: Compare session VAH/VAL/POC using consistent profiles.
items.confirmation_rule: Continuation context when price holds migrated value.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Value Area Migration Down
items.definition: Value area and POC shift lower across sessions.
items.detection_outline: Compare profiles across completed sessions.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Anchored VWAP Reclaim
items.definition: Price recovers an anchored VWAP from an event/swing.
items.detection_outline: Use anchor known at time, compute VWAP then detect cross/reclaim.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Anchored VWAP Rejection
items.definition: Price rejects anchored VWAP from below.
items.detection_outline: Detect approach and close back below anchored VWAP.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Parabolic Run
items.definition: Price acceleration becomes convex with increasing rate of change.
items.detection_outline: Fit log-price slope/curvature and compare to historical thresholds.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Climax Volume Spike
items.definition: Volume is an extreme outlier relative to recent distribution.
items.detection_outline: Rolling robust z-score/percentile of volume, session-time adjusted.
items.confirmation_rule: Interpret with price spread and close location.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Bid-Side Absorption (trade-level)
items.definition: Large aggressive selling is met by replenishing bids with limited downward progress.
items.detection_outline: Use signed trade flow and order-book replenishment at bid; OHLCV cannot verify.
items.invalidation_rule: Bid support depleted and price accepts lower.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Ask-Side Absorption (trade-level)
items.definition: Large aggressive buying is met by replenishing offers with limited upward progress.
items.detection_outline: Use signed trade flow and ask replenishment; require event data.
items.invalidation_rule: Ask liquidity consumed and price accepts higher.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Iceberg Order Inference
items.definition: Repeated executions at a price with displayed depth replenishment.
items.detection_outline: Detect replenishment patterns from order-level data; label as inference only.
items.invalidation_rule: Pattern ceases or price trades through level.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Stop Run Inference
items.definition: Rapid move through clustered stops/liquidity followed by continuation or reversal.
items.detection_outline: Proxy via level sweep, range expansion and order-flow spike; true stop orders are not visible.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Volatility Squeeze Release
items.definition: Low volatility compression transitions into rapid expansion.
items.detection_outline: Band/ATR percentile low then range/volume expansion above threshold.
items.confirmation_rule: Break direction confirmed by close and follow-through.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: ATR Trailing Stop Flip
items.definition: Price crosses a volatility-adjusted trailing stop state.
items.detection_outline: Use explicit ATR multiplier and direction update algorithm.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Parabolic SAR State Flip
items.definition: Price crosses Parabolic SAR, changing its trend state.
items.detection_outline: Compute SAR using specified acceleration parameters.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Weekly Open Reclaim
items.definition: Price reclaims current week open after trading below.
items.detection_outline: Use week boundary per exchange calendar; compare close to weekly open.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Weekly Open Rejection
items.definition: Price tests current week open from below and rejects.
items.detection_outline: Use active week open and detect failed reclaim.
items.no_lookahead_requirement: Pivots, swing levels, zones and higher-timeframe references must be available in real time and never backdated. Track first_knowable_at.

items.name: Monthly Open Reclaim
items.definition: Price recovers month open after trading below.
items.detection_outline: Use calendar/exchange monthly session and active month open.
